notes.title: 1.14update
notes.content:
1. The method of transmitting the ice lake map to the top of the snowfield after it is frozen has been changed from being triggered by the confirm button to being automatically triggered.
2. Fixed the issue of damaged walls inside the Golden Fortress.
3. Fixed the issue of some tree crowns in ancient forests being able to walk.
4. Reduced the probability of counterattack and magical counterattack skills for the "Stone Statue Demon Dragon".
5. Fixed the problem of incorrect transmission position of "residential buildings" in desert wasteland.

notes.title: 1.13 About Adding Archives and Global Variables
notes.content:
1. This update has changed the way archiving is done to display more content and increase convenience in operations.
2. Add a global variable about the opening storyline. When a player has saved a game that has already passed the opening storyline, opening a new game will have an option to skip the opening storyline.

notes.title: 1.11update
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the damage calculation method for "burn", "poisoning", and "bleeding trap" effects.
2. Adjusted the skill value of the Magic Feather skill "Chaos Dark Arrow".
3. Partially adjusted the terrain of ancient forests.
4. Fixed abnormal acquisition of experience coins for Slim and Bat.
5. Fixed the issue of garbled images caused by trolls.
6. Adjusted the control probabilities of "Chaotic Sword Strike", "Eight in a Row Kill", and "[Secret Treasure] Furious Roar".
7. Fixed brightness issue in the image after entering Lava Hell from a desert underground cemetery.
8. Adjusted the control effect of some control skills.
9. Fixed the issue of a probability of transmission errors in the teleportation array.
10. Fixed the issue of some skill text descriptions being incorrect.
11. Fixed the issue of missing job description for Archer's transition to "Magic Feather".
12. Fixed the issue of retaining existing skills after job transfer. Now job transfer will clear all skills, including those learned from skill books. Please be cautious when transferring!
13. Fixed the issue of repeated refreshing of doors that require the "magic key" to be opened, and added a new "magic key" purchase channel in the national capital prop store.
14. NPCs that have added a "delete archive" function in the national capital can delete the first five archives.

notes.title: Large version updates
notes.content:
Main update content:
1. Open a new area called "Lava Purgatory", where players can trigger teleportation points to enter the new area after opening the coffin of the underground cemetery.
2. Add 4 independent maps, 9 new enemies/BOSS, 7 new equipment, and 2 new learnable skills.
3. Add new storylines, NPCs, and interactive methods.
4. Fixed incorrect calculation of defense/magic defense in some skill calculation formulas.
5. Fixed an issue where the passive skill "magic defense increase" failed to correctly increase magic defense.
6. Fixed abnormal issues with the Heavenly Ladder teleportation array.
7. Adjusted the acquisition location of the "Devil Energy Source" in the Heavenly Stairway area, allowing players to enter the new area lava purgatory earlier.
8. Enhanced some skill data for Berserker and Swordsman.
9. Due to the opening of the new DLC, the strength of the "former" enemies has been increased.
10. Adjusted the opening plot.
11. Added passive skills that can be learned at levels 40-50-60.
Finally, due to the replacement of the Steam verification device, the version update has been delayed. We apologize and thank all players for their patience. At the same time, the game is still continuously updated, and thank you all for your support! If you have any opinions or suggestions, please feel free to contact your email 17720405645@163.com Or official QQ group: 653793832.

notes.title: 1.01update
notes.content:
1. Added cooldown time limits to some control skills (Charm, Frozen, Heavenly Punishment, [Treasure] Fury Roar). And slightly increased the basic multiplier of these skills as a balance.
2. Fixed the issue of job transfer, now you can switch professions at any time, whether it's a first or second transfer.
3. Fixed some text issues.
Sincerely thank you for your feedback or suggestions on the game. We will make immediate repairs or fix the corresponding issues in future updates at our discretion! Thank you for playing!
